rfp_text:
REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL — Software Modernization

Section 1.2: Vendors must deliver the system in a reasonable amount of time after award. Section 4.1: Proposers shall demonstrate at least 10 years of experience with similar enterprise systems. Section 5.4: A portion of janitorial and facilities support work may be subcontracted to qualified small businesses.

risks.exact_quote: Vendors must deliver the system in a reasonable amount of time
risks.issue_description: Delivery timeline is not specified, leaving vendors guessing at acceptable durations
risks.reasoning: The phrase 'reasonable amount of time' is subjective and unmeasurable. Different vendors will propose wildly different schedules, making proposals impossible to compare on a common basis.
risks.impact_if_unresolved: Evaluation team cannot objectively compare delivery timelines across proposals
risks.suggested_fix: Replace with a specific deadline or schedule milestones

barriers.exact_quote: Proposers shall demonstrate at least 10 years of experience

requirement_analysis.what_is_required: 10 years of demonstrated experience with similar enterprise systems
requirement_analysis.justification_reasoning: Excessive experience requirement excludes capable smaller firms without clear technical justification

barriers.impact: Effectively bars new entrants and small businesses from competing
barriers.suggestion: Reduce to 3-5 years and accept equivalent recent project experience

questions.predicted_question: What is the required delivery timeline for the modernization work?

triggered_by.exact_quote: Vendors must deliver the system in a reasonable amount of time

confusion_analysis.why_confusing: Without an explicit deadline or milestone schedule, vendors cannot estimate staffing levels, costs, or acceptable risk margins for the proposal.
confusion_analysis.vendor_cannot_determine: Whether to bid an aggressive accelerated schedule or a slower phased rollout

questions.urgency_justification: Schedule shapes price; without a target, every bid will be priced against a different schedule
questions.impact_if_unresolved: Bid prices and proposed approaches will not be comparable
questions.suggested_fix: Specify a target delivery date or required milestone schedule

opportunities.rfp_text: A portion of janitorial and facilities support work may be subcontracted to qualified small businesses
opportunities.reasoning: Janitorial and facilities work is a well-defined, easily separable scope traditionally suited to small business subcontractors and explicitly invited by the RFP.
